reviews.title: My mother worked there. It is shut.
reviews.body:
I ordered the hot turkey on Saturday the 5th because I saw it on here and I wanted to see what would happen. The card was charged $29.11. At 9:40 the app said the restaurant had marked my order complete.

Renner's served its last Sunday dinner on 1 September 2019 and did not open on the Monday. My mother was on the floor there from 1994 until the day it shut. There is a chiropractor in the building now and the telephone number on this page rings at his front desk, which I know because I rang it.

I am not upset about the twenty-nine dollars. I would like the listing taken down. There is no button for that.
